functions.name: ufromfpx
functions.summary: The fromfpx and ufromfpx functions differ from the fromfp and ufromfp functions, respectively, only in that the fromfpx and ufromfpx functions raise the "inexact" floating-point exception if a rounded result not exceeding the specified width differs in value from the argument x.
functions.signature: double ufromfpx(double x, int rnd, unsigned int width);

returns.description: The fromfpx and ufromfpx functions return the rounded integer value. 4 NOTE Conversions to integer types that are not required to raise the inexact exception can be done simply by rounding to integral value in floating type and then converting to the target integer type. For example, the conversion of long double x to uint64_t, using upward rounding, is done by (uint64_t)ceill(x)
